description: Which US sales tax rates or boundaries changed this quarter? Rate, ZIP+4 and boundary change records for the 24 Streamlined Sales Tax states, computed by Distill from each state’s SST files. Change records read from the states’ rate and boundary files: rates that change, begin or end; ZIP+4 and 5-digit ZIP ranges whose jurisdictions change; new files posted. Each record cites the sha256 of the files it came from. Pages of up to 100, oldest first; pass next_cursor back as cursor. Updated quarterly. Price: $0.05 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (change records are read from the state files deterministically): 1 until the next SST posting deadline (the 1st of Mar, Jun, Sep or Dec) after the files were last checked, then halving every 30 days. Not tax advice. Rates as published by the state in its Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the stated effective period; verify with the state. See /terms.
